facebook.caption:
Locals don't post about Bãi Dài. So we will.

While the tour buses unload at the crowded south, this long stretch of sand sits mostly empty. No beach clubs fighting for space. No hawkers every 10 meters. Just flat water, soft sand, and room to breathe.

4.3★ from people who actually found it. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
